verses.t: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū hatthanillehakaṁ bhuñjanti …pe…. Na hatthanillehakaṁ bhuñjitabbaṁ. Yo anādariyaṁ paṭicca hatthanillehakaṁ bhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ādikammikassāti. Dutiyasikkhāpadaṁ niṭṭhitaṁ.
